tools.description: Clicks and QR scans for one of the user's own Snip links: totals, by day, by hour of the day on plans with time-of-day analytics, and the top countries, referring sites and devices. tools.name: get_account_stats
tools.description: Clicks and QR scans across every link in the user's Snip account: totals, by day, the busiest links, and the top countries, referring sites and devices. Needs the user signed in to Snip. Use this for questions like "how are my links doing" or "which link got the most scans this week".

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: The user's Snip links, newest first, with their destinations and click counts. Needs the user signed in to Snip. Pass a search to match an ending, a destination or a title.

tools.name: list_domains

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_qr_code, save_page, drop_file · Private data: make_qr_code, shorten_link, drop_file, get_link_stats, list_domains · Public sink: make_qr_code, save_page, drop_file, update_link · Destructive: drop_file, delete_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_qr_code, save_page, drop_file · Private data: make_qr_code, shorten_link, drop_file, get_link_stats, list_domains · Public sink: make_qr_code, save_page, drop_file, update_link · Destructive: drop_file, delete_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
